# AZ Restaurant Partners

> The technology team an independent restaurant does not have. AZ studies how a restaurant actually
> runs, finds where its money is going, then buys, connects or builds whatever fixes it — and operates
> it afterwards. Not a product, not a one-off project. One partner responsible for every part of the
> restaurant that runs on technology: getting found (Google and AI answers), winning the order (an AI
> phone line that writes orders into the POS, direct ordering), growing the order (upsell, pricing,
> catering), keeping the guest (reviews, loyalty, win-back, a guest list the owner owns), keeping the
> money (true profit rather than card totals), and watching all of it (nightly checks, alerts, weekly
> improvements). Sometimes the highest-return fix is not software at all, and AZ builds those too.
> Founded and run by Abbas Zoeb, who engineered at Google, worked on Hard Rock Cafe's first AI agents
> earlier in his career in enterprise software, and owns Wok & Karahi in Spring, TX — where every
> system runs first. The owner keeps every account, login and customer record in their own name and
> can leave at any time with all of it still working.
>
> Serving Spring, The Woodlands, greater Houston and across Texas.
>
> Pricing: founding partners pay nothing for the first three months — no monthly fee, no build or
> setup charges, no contract. After that, from $99/month to operate everything, with custom work
> quoted per job and approved before it starts. No equity and no percentage of sales. Five founding
> restaurants only; two are taken.

## What AZ does (offerings)
- Commission Rescue — move orders off the ~30% third-party delivery apps to first-party ordering.
- AI Phone Agent — answer every call 24/7, take orders into the POS, book tables, handle catering.
- Get found by AI & Google — AEO/SEO so AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) and search recommend the restaurant.
- More 5-star reviews — solicit happy guests, intercept unhappy ones before they post.
- Win back regulars — loyalty, consent-based SMS, and a guest list the owner owns.
- Catering & corporate lunches — a real off-premise channel at higher margins.
- End the tablet chaos — delivery apps consolidated into one POS/kitchen.
- See your numbers — one clear dashboard of sales, labor, and food cost across locations.
- Custom engineering — when no existing tool fits, AZ builds the software (or the non-software play) the restaurant uniquely needs.
